meaning:
1) dwelling, habitation, refuge
1a) lair, refuge (of jackals)
1b) dwelling

renderings.kjv: thou hast been our dwelling place

elsewhere.note: Look down from your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless your people Israel, and the ground which you have given us, as you swore to our fathers, a land…
Why do you kick at my sacrifice and at my offering, which I have commanded in my habitation, and honor your sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the best…
Then the Levitical priests arose and blessed the people. Their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy habitation, even to heaven.
Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
“I will make Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling place of jackals. I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”
Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion and the lioness walked, the lion’s cubs, and no one made them afraid?
I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction, so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her.” But they rose early…
Be silent, all flesh, before Yahweh; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation!”
